abstract: A 2-month-old male Holstein calf showed clinical signs of abdominal bloating, melena, and pain and was suspected of having a perforating abomasal ulcer. Necropsy revealed a large mass located preferentially around the abomasum and a large perforating abomasal ulcer on the pyloric antrum. Milky white masses of various sizes were also found in the abdominal cavity that consisted of agglutinated nodules ranging in size from a pinhead to a golf ball and were distributed on the surfaces of the liver, reticulum, omasum, abomasum, and diaphragm. Microscopic examination revealed that the masses were composed primarily of hyaline matrices, epithelioid tumor cells, and large atypical cells with hyaline droplets and/or vacuoles. Stromal hyaline matrices and hyaline droplets of the large tumor cells stained positive with periodic acid-Schiff stain. Tumor cells showed a positive reaction to anti-human alpha-fetoprotein, which is a marker of yolk sac tumors. These findings strongly suggested that the masses found in the abdominal cavity were yolk sac tumor, a rare germ cell tumor in cattle.
abstract_ja: 生後2か月の雄のホルスタイン子牛が腹部膨満、タール便、疼痛を示し、穿孔性皺胃潰瘍が疑われた。剖検では皺胃周囲に大きな腫瘤、幽門洞に大きな穿孔性皺胃潰瘍を認めた。また、腹腔内には肝臓、網胃、重弁胃、皺胃、横隔膜の表面に散在する、ピンの頭大からゴルフボール大までの乳白色の塊が認められた。塊は凝集した結節で構成されていた。顕微鏡検査では、塊は主に硝子様基質、類上皮様腫瘍細胞、硝子滴および/または空胞を有する大型異型細胞から構成されていた。間質の硝子様基質と大型腫瘍細胞の硝子滴は過ヨウ素酸シッフ(PAS)染色陽性であった。腫瘍細胞は抗ヒトαフェトプロテイン(AFP)に陽性反応を示し、これは卵黄嚢腫瘍のマーカーである。これらの所見から、腹腔内の塊は牛における稀な胚細胞腫瘍である卵黄嚢腫瘍であることが強く示唆された。
